verdict.rationale: Postman docs describe local collections/requests and CLI/mock features that could work locally, but there's no explicit documentation of a fully offline, no-account mode; multiple independent hands-on reports directly contradict the claim, describing forced account creation prompts that wiped local collections, mandatory startup calls to Postman's servers, and telemetry uploading secrets/environment data even when working 'offline'. missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of an offline/local-only mode, confirmation that no telemetry or account check occurs without internet, and evidence that data persists without cloud sync.
